proposal_quality.source_scope: Entire shared proposal, including background, design, decisions and examples
proposal_quality.classification: Eight narrower missing contracts plus one existing dimensionality inconsistency. Earlier legacy contradictions are closed. These are not nine missing functional requirements.

semantic_gaps.name: Legacy contradictions
semantic_gaps.already_defined: The editorial revision removes obsolete callable interfaces, translate placement and binding-helper reset authoring. Reference-based binding remains the shared representation.
semantic_gaps.remaining: No remaining legacy contradiction in these sections. The earlier relationship carrier is an implementation departure, not an unspecified binding choice.

semantic_gaps.name: Exact CRS placement property contract
semantic_gaps.already_defined: Separate CRS position, orientation and scale resolve before ordinary USD transforms. Direct binding sets the placement boundary; source positions interpolate before conversion.
semantic_gaps.remaining: Property names, types, defaults or requiredness, applicability, and the bases and mutual order of orientation and scale are not defined. Internal differentiation or caching methods are implementation freedom.

semantic_gaps.name: Physical coordinate context of project adjustments
semantic_gaps.already_defined: Ordinary project adjustments apply after CRS placement. The adjusted physical placement survives output selection, including adjusted imagery. An enclosing binding supplies working context without replacing an independent source CRS.
semantic_gaps.remaining: The authored coordinate frame giving an adjustment its physical meaning, and its derivation through nested scopes and output changes, are not specified. Adjusted measurements are not a new functional scope question.

semantic_gaps.name: Remaining component conventions and scene result domain
semantic_gaps.already_defined: Projected X/Y/Z means easting/northing/up. Geographic source positions and geographic coordinate queries are supported. Writers author stage-convention correctives.
semantic_gaps.remaining: Other CRS component sets lack a complete mapping to authored placement components. Geographic scene geometry, frames and bounds remain separate from permitted geographic coordinate queries.

semantic_gaps.name: Prescribed WKT string normalization profile
semantic_gaps.already_defined: The complete WKT definition is authoritative. Requirement 31 requires normalized serialized text while preserving represented information. Token equality and geodetic equivalence are distinct.
semantic_gaps.remaining: The required normal form is not prescribed or normatively referenced. A projection library round trip or a hand-chosen whitespace rule cannot establish proposal conformance.

semantic_gaps.name: Measurement-coordinate association
semantic_gaps.already_defined: Nearest direct binding defines composed subtree CRS scope. Measurement values retain their coordinate/time associations. Ordinary geometry vertices are offsets.
semantic_gaps.remaining: The authored association identifying which properties or external-asset coordinates carry measurement positions is missing. Vector shape or property name cannot identify the role.

semantic_gaps.name: Dependency declaration carrier and composition
semantic_gaps.already_defined: A declaration must expose dependency without traversal and cover all placed content, including referenced and unloaded content and resolved export.
semantic_gaps.remaining: The authored carrier and its composition rules are not specified. Searching for applied bindings does not satisfy a declaration promised without traversal.

semantic_gaps.name: Extent and comparable-result agreement contract
semantic_gaps.already_defined: The engine selects operations and manages transformation resources. Results identify the operation and attributed accuracy. Consumers share resolution. Placement distance and extent must be stated.
semantic_gaps.remaining: The claimed approximation domain and its satisfaction/reporting, comparable operations and agreement measure remain unspecified, including geographic distance. Full placement-chain accuracy propagation is not a requirement-28 obligation. Missing consumer tests are verification work.

semantic_gaps.name: Export sampling-record representation
semantic_gaps.already_defined: Explicit export records its output CRS and sampling, preserves values and associations, and rereads without repeating source conversion or private resolved flags.
semantic_gaps.remaining: The authored sampling record must distinguish interpolation of exported samples from resolution of original source samples. Lost properties and fixture-specific export names are implementation defects, not new functional gaps.

semantic_gaps.name: Existing dimensionality inconsistency
semantic_gaps.already_defined: The background requires 3D CRS definitions. Missing height or unsupported transformations must not be guessed.
semantic_gaps.remaining: The detailed schema and UTM appendix contain two-axis WKT examples. Reconcile whether they illustrate horizontal components or permit complete bound definitions. Do not silently broaden scope. This run uses only complete 3D examples.

requirements.title: Self-contained definitions
requirements.normative_statement: A CRS carried in a scene can be read from the scene alone, without a lookup against an external registry.
requirements.current_evidence: CRS discovery/composition only

requirements.title: Defined once, and describing no object
requirements.normative_statement: A complete CRS definition used in many places is authored once and referred to, describes no object-specific placement, orientation or scale, and has its authored WKT as the sole authored authority for the information that WKT determines.
requirements.current_evidence: CRS discovery/composition only

requirements.title: Datum, realization and epoch
requirements.normative_statement: The scene can identify the datum realization and any frame reference epoch defined by its CRS, without inferring a coordinate epoch for the coordinates.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: A site's own grid is a CRS like any other
requirements.normative_statement: A project grid — its origin, orientation and scale relative to a geodetic or projected CRS, and, where applicable, its heights relative to a vertical CRS, agreed once for a site — can be the CRS its content is expressed in, and content in it needs nothing that content in a national grid does not.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: A discoverable CRS
requirements.normative_statement: The CRS in which any authored position is expressed can be determined from the scene alone.
requirements.current_evidence: CRS discovery/composition only

requirements.title: Declared for a subtree, not a prim
requirements.normative_statement: A CRS declared once applies to the content beneath it, and part of that content can declare a different one.
requirements.current_evidence: CRS discovery/composition only

requirements.title: Composition agnostic
requirements.normative_statement: CRS declarations and their scope are interpreted on the composed stage, following the composition and value-resolution rules of the [AOUSD USD Core Specification v1.0.1](https://github.com/aousd/specifications-public/blob/main/core/1.0.1/core_spec.md).
requirements.current_evidence: CRS discovery/composition only

requirements.title: Brought-in data keeps its coordinates and its CRS
requirements.normative_statement: Data authored in one CRS can be brought into a project working in another, and given project-specific placement, with its authored coordinate values and CRS unchanged and that placement preserved in any supported requested output CRS.
requirements.current_evidence: CRS discovery/composition only

requirements.title: Positions, and offsets from them
requirements.normative_statement: Content is placed by a position, orientation and scale with defined meaning in a named CRS, and the content beneath that placement is authored and moved as ordinary scene offsets in scene distances by someone who need know no geodesy.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: Offsets along the axes of their position
requirements.normative_statement: Offsets beneath a CRS placement have an orientation and scale discoverable from its authored placement and CRS without resolving into another CRS, and resolution accounts for changes in local axes and scale as well as position.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: Position or offset, and the scene says which
requirements.normative_statement: Whether an authored location is a position in a CRS or an offset from its parent can be read from the scene, and a CRS position does not accumulate ancestor xformOps.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: No angle read as a length
requirements.normative_statement: Every coordinate's unit, and the surface its height is measured from, are unambiguous, and no reading of the scene takes an angular coordinate as a scene distance.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: One axis mapping
requirements.normative_statement: Which scene axis carries which CRS component is fixed by this proposal, the same for every CRS and every implementation, and never taken from the axis order a CRS declares: where a CRS has easting, northing and up, X carries easting, Y northing, Z up, right-handed.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: Scene conventions stay the scene's
requirements.normative_statement: A CRS binding changes neither the scene's units nor its up axis, and where a CRS's units or axes differ from the scene's, the relation between the two is defined by this proposal once, not by each implementation.
requirements.current_evidence: CRS discovery/composition only

requirements.title: Placement separate from conformance
requirements.normative_statement: Where an instance sits is recorded separately from the corrections that adapt its source asset's conventions.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: One CRS out
requirements.normative_statement: Content expressed in any number of CRSs resolves into one output CRS selected by the consumer, with the scene able to name a default for consumers that make no selection.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: The same answer for every consumer
requirements.normative_statement: A world position, a bound, an instance, a physics body and a rendered image all come from the same resolution, and none of them needs a renderer.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: Coordinates back out
requirements.normative_statement: Any resolved position can be reported as coordinates in any CRS the scene or the consumer names, and the placement of one prim relative to another can be asked for in the output CRS.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: Resolution leaves the scene as authored
requirements.normative_statement: Resolving a scene writes nothing into it — authored coordinates, placement values, CRS definitions and bindings are unchanged — and writing a resolved result out is a separate, explicit act that records the CRS it was written in and, for content that varies over time, how it was sampled.
requirements.current_evidence: CRS discovery/composition only

requirements.title: Positions between recorded moments
requirements.normative_statement: A position recorded as samples over time is interpolated on the recorded values, in the CRS they were recorded in, and converting the result to another CRS does not change the path.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: Never placed by a guess
requirements.normative_statement: A requested transformation outside the supported scope or one that cannot be computed — no engine, a definition that cannot be read or is unsupported, a missing grid, a point outside the transformation's domain of validity, a requested change of coordinate epoch that the operation does not model — never places content by a substitute, a result that could only be partly computed is a failure and not a partial placement, and the failure surfaces where it can be known: in validation for what the authored scene reveals, from the engine for what only resolution can discover.
requirements.current_evidence: CRS discovery/composition only

requirements.title: A CRS suited to the project's size
requirements.normative_statement: The scheme supports site, regional and global projects without requiring their geometry to be approximated by a single tangent plane.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: Detail that does not depend on location
requirements.normative_statement: Changing only an asset's geospatial placement does not reduce the precision of its asset-relative geometry as authored.

requirements.title: Extent under one position is bounded and stated
requirements.normative_statement: Content beneath one position is placed to within a stated distance of where placing each of its points would put it, and the extent over which that holds is stated.
requirements.current_evidence: Dependent resolution not executed in this run

requirements.title: Additive for consumers that ignore it
requirements.normative_statement: A consumer that does not interpret the geospatial information reads the same scene it would have read without it.

requirements.title: Declares its dependency
requirements.normative_statement: A scene whose correct placement depends on resolving CRSs says so, in a way a consumer can read without traversing the scene, and the declaration covers every piece of placed content in it.

requirements.title: Checkable before use
requirements.normative_statement: What the scene itself establishes — a position nested beneath another position, a binding to no definition, content outside any CRS, a dependency declaration missing or left behind by a written-out result — can be detected in the authored scene without resolving it.

requirements.title: A result says what produced it
requirements.normative_statement: A resolved result can name the coordinate operation that produced it and the accuracy attributed to it.

requirements.title: Implementable from the text alone
requirements.normative_statement: Two implementations built from this proposal without consulting its authors give the same coordinate interpretation and, using equivalent coordinate operations, place the same scene within a stated agreement distance in the output CRS's units at a stated coordinate magnitude.

requirements.title: Measurements remain usable as data
requirements.normative_statement: Georeferenced measurements remain accessible to consumers together with their associated positions and times, without requiring renderable geometry or a visualization, and coordinate resolution preserves those associations and measurement values.

proposal_quality.process_correction: Read the entire pinned proposal. Cite existing answers before identifying the smallest missing authored fact or observable meaning. A chosen internal algorithm or an absent test is not a new proposal gap. Stop the dependent derivation. Never certify a private experimental model as shared-proposal authority.
stopping_policy: At each required semantic choice, cite its exact proposal clause or explicit normative reference.
If that source is missing or conflicting, stop the dependent derivation and immediately report the gap, affected requirement and proposed alternatives.
Continue only independent work or explicitly authorized labeled experiments. Keep their assumptions separate from proposal conformance.
Review any proposed specification repair against requirements and data ownership. Do not approve it because the implementation already uses it.
A semantic change requires a new pinned specification before affected code/tests and invalidates affected evidence.
A missing required test is unfinished verification, not an open design question.
The default build gate stops while specification gaps remain. An explicit experimental invocation records proposal_ready=false and requirements_build_complete=false.

limitations: This run verifies CRS discovery, composition, definition property types and source preservation; it does not certify the unspecified WKT normal form.
Native USD discovery is not Hydra placement or rendering. Live OV discovery is not resolved geometry ingestion.
Missing placement, component, adjustment, measurement, declaration, result and export definitions stop dependent derivation.
The retained earlier relationship-based experiment is incompatible with the shared binding format and was not rerun or silently adopted.
No previous numerical result, image, export or deck is relabeled as newly executed evidence.
